summary: Lattice (built combinations frame + save/load snapshot persistence) and LatticeIndex (partition-key routing over multiple lattices with load-time ambiguity validation). Largest module in the package.
lifecycle_notes: Lattice.save/load added: parquet + manifest.yaml snapshot round-trip (a superset of babel's LatticeManifest) — the prior profile's coverage.md flagged 'no serialisation protocol' as an open question; that gap is now closed. 'Build offline, save, serve apply from load.'
Lattice.is_composed added to distinguish build() output (has __prime_product) from flat/imported lattices.

LatticeIndex is new: routes CONTEXT_KEY-partitioned contexts via ternary + specificity semantics through an embedded meta-engine; index(lattices, validate=True, max_witnesses=1_000_000) runs an exhaustive witness-matrix ambiguity check at load time; ties raise AmbiguousPartitionError (a KeyError subclass).
documentation_hooks: mountainash-rules-babel docs/lattice-schema.md (export schema contract for save/load)
risks: Lattice.load carries a documented '# allow:' backend-purity exemption for the parquet read, pending backend-agnostic parquet.read_table support in mountainash.
